verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several of its own export paths: CSV downloads from analytics tables, one-click export of case information, a Reports History export of case data including comments, and APIs for listing and fetching cases for data syncing. Nothing shows a complete, all-data export (attachments, CRM profiles, audit trail, filings) or an account-exit process, and only the analytics export is stated to be an open format (CSV). Missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk export of all data types, stated open formats for case/report exports, an offboarding/data-portability process, and independent corroboration.
